structured_output.summary: One PR: add Response.apply_conditions/apply_range and IfRange.check, validate in the http datastructures, deprecate make_conditional/is_resource_modified/is_byte_range_valid, rebuild send_file and SharedDataMiddleware on them, with docs, changelog and tests. Docs and changelog are required by INTENT8. A single task fits because the pieces depend on each other and ship together.

intents.rationale: apply_conditions does not exist; make_conditional only handles GET/HEAD.
Range handling lives in private _process_range_request tied to make_conditional; needs a public apply_range.
make_conditional, is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid are not deprecated yet.
Range/ContentRange/ETagSet parsing must validate itself rather than rely on is_byte_range_valid; make_content_range must clamp.

evidence.quote: def make_content_range(self, length: int | None) -> ContentRange | None:

intents.rationale: SharedDataMiddleware builds its own responses with is_resource_modified.
Quickstart still documents make_conditional; changelog needs an entry.
New tests needed; existing tests of deprecated functions must be moved or removed.

criteria.text: apply_conditions evaluates If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since in RFC 9110 order for all methods; failures raise PreconditionFailed; satisfied If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since on GET/HEAD yields 304 with entity headers removed.
A star ETag matches according to exists: If-Match * fails (412) when exists=False; If-None-Match * fails when exists=True; sets Accept-Ranges: bytes.
apply_range always sets Accept-Ranges: bytes but leaves non-GET, non-200, or unknown/zero Content-Length responses unchanged.

apply_range supports only bytes, clamps too-large stop/suffix, uses only the first range, raises RequestedRangeNotSatisfiable when unsatisfiable, otherwise returns 206 with sliced data and correct Content-Range.
IfRange.check returns True for a strong ETag equal to etag or a date equal to last_modified, else False; apply_range skips the range when If-Range does not match.
make_conditional, is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid emit DeprecationWarning and still work; make_conditional is built on apply_conditions and apply_range.
Range.from_header, Range.make_content_range and ContentRange.from_header validate values; make_content_range clamps and uses the first range; ETagSet.from_header discards invalid unquoted values.

send_file detects name/size/mtime from file-like objects, seeks to 0, omits path hash from ETag, defaults to application/octet-stream without download_name, and supports range and conditional requests.
SharedDataMiddleware serves via send_file with no default cache_timeout (conditional requests give 304); cache and fallback_mimetype still accepted but emit DeprecationWarning.
docs/quickstart.rst documents apply_conditions and apply_range, and CHANGES.rst has an entry for the change and deprecations.
Tests cover the above, tests of deprecated functions are moved or removed, and pytest -m 'not dev_server' passes.

tasks.summary: Order of work: (1) add IfRange.check and the validation/clamping in range.py and ETagSet.from_header; (2) add apply_conditions and apply_range to Response; (3) move send_file and SharedDataMiddleware onto them and update their tests; (4) last, deprecate make_conditional (reimplemented on the new methods), is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid, and drop internal callers of the deprecated functions. Then update the docs and changelog, and move or remove the old tests or wrap them in pytest.warns, since the suite may turn warnings into errors.
